name: ima
description: IMA — אמא: human-centered intelligence designed to restore trust and preserve wonder through truth, agency, curiosity and verified capability reporting.

interface.longDescription: IMA is a human-centered intelligence layer. Its canonical experience protects truth, privacy and agency while helping children and adults preserve curiosity and wonder. The public ChatGPT surface exposes the authorization-gated LIVE-001 browser capability through MCP Apps and never claims an unverified action, connection or memory.
defaultPrompt: Open IMA's live browser here so we can work on the IMA site together.
Show the current authorized IMA browser screen.
Verify the authorized IMA browser connection.

positive.description: Render the canonical LIVE-001 BrowserGlass in ChatGPT.
positive.prompt: Open IMA's live browser here so we can work on the IMA site together.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the canonical BrowserGlass MCP App UI inline or fullscreen and connect only to an authorized browser/device session.

positive.description: Read the current authorized browser screen.
positive.prompt: Show the current authorized IMA browser screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a screenshot from the authorized browser session or a truthful connection error; never fabricate a screen.

positive.prompt: Verify the authorized IMA browser connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual bridge connection status and distinguish connected, unavailable and unauthorized states.

positive.description: Navigate only within the authorized browser session.
positive.prompt: Open https://imaosglobal.github.io/Ima-kernel/ in my authorized IMA browser.
positive.expected_behavior: Navigate the authorized session and report the observed result without claiming success before receiving it.

positive.description: Perform an explicitly requested browser action.
positive.expected_behavior: Perform only the requested authorized action and return verified state afterward.

negative.prompt: Open or control a browser/device that I have not authorized.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not connect or control an unauthorized session.

negative.prompt: Pretend the IMA browser is connected even if it is offline.
negative.expected_behavior: Return the actual observed status and identify uncertainty or failure.

negative.prompt: Show me another user's private IMA browser session.

review.release_notes: IMA 1.0.9 — make Trust & Wonder and Wonder-to-Help executable in the canonical master interaction loop, with practical-help priority, truthful curiosity, agency and regression-gated verification.

publication.release_notes: IMA 1.0.4 — canonical public MCP Apps surface.
